observations.why: Directive cadence imposed with urgency-as-worry: the 'from now on' framing carries activated pressure that an unrehearsed rollback is a live danger.
Aphoristic sharpening of a danger into a categorical loss — the speaker performs alarm that an unrehearsed rollback equals no rollback at all.

mints.name: RehearsalAsPossession
mints.title: a rollback we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is the speaker converting a preparedness gap into a categorical loss-of-capability claim to register urgency?
